newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch shares end off, lower Wall St blocks uptrend.
newsitem.headline: Dutch shares end off, lower Wall St blocks uptrend.

text.p: Dutch shares closed down on Wednesday after a lower Wall Street opening blocked uptrend in the middle of the afternoon.
The Dutch AEX share index, closed 1.31 points lower at 587.84, after hitting an intra-day high of 590.76 points.
Dealers said the advance earlier was hesitant and a further correction on Wall Street could halt recent upswing. "But sentiment remains good in the longer run," said one dealer.
Philips outperformed the market and added 1.30 guilders to 64.10. Another index heavyweight, Royal Dutch dropped 3.80 guilders to 279.60 on profit taking after recent rise.
